items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the equivalence of the derived category of quasi-coherent modules on a scheme with that on its small etale site via epsilon^* (source lines 401-470, label lemma-derived-quasi-coherent-small-etale-site). The solver must assemble the quasi-inverse on the derived level from module-level data: compute cohomology sheaves of the pushforward through an affine-vanishing argument, sheafify, and verify both adjunction maps; the derived-level bookkeeping across the two topologies is not a routine citation. Allowed background: the Descent equivalences and cohomology lemmas cited, delivered as navigation pointers.
